definitions.explanation: The philosophical and ethical system based on the teachings of Confucius, emphasizing moral virtue, social harmony, filial piety, and proper conduct in relationships.

notes:
Confucianism was introduced to Japan from China and had a significant influence on Japanese society, particularly during the Edo period (1603-1868) when it was promoted by the Tokugawa shogunate. Core values include ⟦{仁|じん}→仁：23044_jin⟧ (benevolence), {義|ぎ} (righteousness), ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ (propriety), and {孝|こう} (filial piety).
